title: Balaam and Balak
description: The story of Balaam, who was summoned by King Balak to curse Israel but, after being stopped on the way by an angel visible only to his donkey, ended up blessing Israel three times.

versions.reason: [major] references: The narrative overlaps with the existing 'Balaam's Donkey' (Num 22:21-35) but covers a much broader story (chapters 22–24). They should be merged as they form the same overarching narrative about Balaam.
